$comment: STT render-kernel shader-codegen contract (renderer-abstraction-2026-06 §5.1). The scalar time-filter alpha is authored once as an Expr AST in @poopdeck.gl/core/shader-codegen and machine-emitted per backend. This file STATES the frozen op-set so it is a declared contract, not something discovered by reading emitters. Enforced by packages/core/test/render-spec-contract.test.ts — the ALPHA_EXPR ASTs must stay inside `ops` and `variables`, and adding an op is gated on every emitter listed in `emitters` compiling it.

opSemantics.step: step(edge, x) = x >= edge ? 1 : 0 (GLSL step argument order)
opSemantics.select: select(c, t, f) = c != 0 ? t : f; emitted as a ternary and evaluated lazily, so an untaken div-by-zero branch is never computed

emitters.name: emitTSL
emitters.status: planned — three still uses hand-written TSL nodes pinned to the CPU oracle by parity tests

exclusions.$comment: Deliberately OUTSIDE the frozen op-set; each stays per-backend, pinned to the CPU oracle by parity tests rather than codegen.
exclusions.wakeSizeScale: vertex-stage size multiplier (not a fragment alpha)
